title: Story premise ENT058: The Spiral Lock That Shows Its Work
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: The lock is not guessing. We are. Takeaway/theme: Make the hidden condition visible before trying more moves.
description: A keeper must release a toy treasure tray using three concentric rings, but random turns keep hiding the exit slot. A cutaway reveals that every ring needs its notch at the top; the keeper aligns the outer, middle, and inner notches and slides out a single celebratory biscuit.
